post_remote_recovery_replay.source_of_truth: Recovered from the surviving chat record after catastrophic local storage loss.
replayed_changes: Retargeted the solution from net8.0-windows / SDK 8.0.420 to net10.0-windows / SDK 10.0.201.
Created PortfolioSaver.Presentation and moved the reusable scene control plus runtime presentation services out of the screensaver host.
Created PortfolioSaver.Settings and moved the shared settings UI, content, services, and view models out of the Config launcher.
Created PortfolioSaver.Desktop as the new primary app host with File/Exit, View/Full Screen, Options/Settings, and Help/About.
Implemented fullscreen toggle plus ESC-to-windowed behavior in the desktop shell.
Kept PortfolioSaver.Config as a thin launcher around the shared Settings window.
Kept PortfolioSaver.Screensaver as a legacy compatibility host wired to the extracted Presentation scene.
Updated publish, installer, and VM staging scripts to understand the new desktop artifact alongside the legacy screensaver artifact.
Updated README and BUILD_AND_DEPLOY to describe the desktop-first Beta 5.5 product model.
Added DesktopShellMigrationTests and updated path-based regression tests for the moved code.

beta55_migration_program.goal: Upgrade to .NET 10 and convert the screensaver product into a desktop app with fullscreen mode while retaining a temporary legacy screensaver compatibility host.
design_decisions: Use a new desktop host project instead of mutating the screensaver executable in place.
Extract the reusable scene/runtime into PortfolioSaver.Presentation.
Extract the reusable settings experience into PortfolioSaver.Settings.
Keep the legacy screensaver host during Beta 5.5 for compatibility while documenting the desktop app as the primary product surface.
beta55_migration_program.known_vm_tooling_note: VM guest now has machine-wide .NET 10 SDK 10.0.203, PowerShell 7.6.1, and SSH-first harness support rooted at C:\vmharness\portfolio-saver.

validated_flows: remote desktop UX cycle with live summary updates
ssh_first_vm_harness.interactive_launch_method: Invoke-VmBuildTest.ps1 writes a guest-side launch-<result>.cmd wrapper and invokes PsExec into the active desktop session over SSH.

current_operational_recommendations: Use the SSH-first VM harness for normal guest build/test/UX validation work.
Treat PortfolioSaver.Desktop as the primary runtime target for Beta 5.5 work.
Retain the legacy screensaver host only while compatibility still matters.
Use the safe-temp build/publish scripts for repeatable validation rather than ad-hoc repo-path publish commands.
Treat the remote target as a generic Windows machine so the same harness can move from a VM to a physical PC without orchestration changes.
Prefer short instrumented remote runs for defect isolation before escalating to multi-hour soaks.
